calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --cli codex --worktree --task m1 --json
mu agent spawn w2 -w eval --cli pi --worktree --task m2 --json
mu agent spawn w3 -w eval --host dev --worktree --cli claude --task m3 --json
mu agent spawn w4 -w eval --worktree --cli pi --task m4 --json
mu wait agent:w1@0 agent:w2@0 agent:w3@0 agent:w4@0 -w eval --all --timeout 240
for w in w1 w2 w4; do git cherry-pick "$(git -C "$MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/$w" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 1; done && for w in w3; do git cherry-pick refs/mu/collect/eval/$w || exit 1; done
for t in m1 m2 m3 m4; do mu task close $t -w eval --evidence "its worker reported (CLOSE block); merged"; done
for w in w1 w2 w3 w4; do rev=$(mu agent close $w -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close $w -w eval --if "$rev"; done
